sentence: This project builds a computational framework that helps chemical and energy systems making multiple products learn and coordinate without sharing all their data.
This project holds a workshop where experts discuss how to move from noisy quantum computers to quantum computers that handle errors.
This project compares historical and contemporary collections of wild house mice to find genomic changes that help them adapt to urban growth.
This project studies the genes that make the stem cells in maize flowers stop growing at the right time.
This project builds mathematical and computational tools that help design systems with a chosen nonlinear response.
This project studies how to build machine learning models that detect and classify objects well and resist nefarious data.
This project builds computer models of how ionizing radiation moves through the low-density atoms between galaxies in the early Universe.
This project builds methods that combine traffic flow models with machine learning to estimate and predict mobility patterns.
This project builds methods that let AI models learn from data spread across wireless networks while protecting privacy.
This project studies how human and natural systems in coastal zones could move inland together as sea level rise increases.
This project studies a way for machine learning to represent concepts as boxes instead of single points.
This project builds a security framework and policies that make secure research computing easier to access for more users.
This project builds ways to place deuterium and tritium isotopes into pharmaceutical molecules by combining two catalytic approaches.
This project studies how land left after property buyouts can be managed to give ecological benefits and match community preferences.
This project holds a workshop where researchers use computer methods to study four-dimensional spaces with the theory of trisections.
